summary: HUNTIQ V3 frontend-backend integration testing complete. 24/24 backend API tests passed. All 3 dashboards (Core Dashboard, Plan Maître, Business) load correctly and display data. Frontend services gracefully fall back to placeholder data when backend endpoints don't exist. Key finding: Some frontend service endpoints don't match backend routes - frontend uses fallback data.

features_tested.notes: Weather data displayed (8°C, 72% humidity, 12 km/h wind, 1015 hPa). Conditions de Chasse 72%. All 5 tabs working (Vue d'ensemble, Météo, Analyse, Stratégie, Assistant IA).
Frontend calls /api/v1/weather/current which returns 404. Falls back to placeholder data (8°C, 72%, etc). Backend has /api/v1/weather/score endpoint instead.
Frontend calls /api/v1/weather/hunting-conditions which returns 404. Falls back to placeholder showing 72% score.
Displays 72 Grade B for Conditions, 72 Index Chasse. Data from placeholder fallback.
Frontend calls /api/v1/ai/insights which returns 404. Falls back to contextual placeholder messages.
Page loads correctly with all 5 tabs (Vue d'ensemble, Prédiction, Faune, Territoire, Communauté).
Products displayed with scores (92, 88, 84, 80, 76). Backend /api/v1/recommendation/products returns real data.
Shows 68% with 85% confidence. Frontend calls /api/v1/predictive/success which returns 404. Uses placeholder data.
Wildlife Engine shows moderate activity, 60% score, peak hours 06:00-08:00 and 17:00-19:00. Backend /api/v1/wildlife/predict-activity works.
All 7 species clickable (Cerf de Virginie, Orignal, Ours noir, Sanglier, Dindon sauvage, Canard, Oie). Species change updates all components correctly.
Dashboard loads correctly with all 5 tabs (Vue d'ensemble, Produits, Commandes, Clients, Fournisseurs). Shows 0 products, 0 commandes, 0 clients (empty state).
Homepage loads with hero section, navigation links (Dashboard, Business, Plan Maître), Analyze/Compare/Order buttons.
Returns score 9.0, activity_level 'peak', rating 'Excellent' for test parameters.
Returns 10 product recommendations with scores, reasons, and confidence values.
